question_text: What may result from taking part in illegal road races?

options.text: The occurrence of serious road traffic accidents
The imposition of a term of imprisonment on the vehicle driver
The confiscation of the vehicle driver's driving licence

correct_answers.text: The occurrence of serious road traffic accidents
The imposition of a term of imprisonment on the vehicle driver
The confiscation of the vehicle driver's driving licence

comment: Participation in illegal road races can lead to serious traffic accidents and can result in a custodial sentence for the driver and the revocation of the driver's licence.

question_text: A 2.50 m wide motor vehicle is loaded with bulky goods projecting laterally more than 50 cm over the side and rear lights. What must be remembered when transporting the load?

options.text: The extra-wide load must be marked to the front and rear
A special permit from the road traffic licensing authority must be carried
If an amber rotating lamp is used, the load can be transported as a matter of course

correct_answers.text: The extra-wide load must be marked to the front and rear
A special permit from the road traffic licensing authority must be carried

comment: If your load 50 cm extends laterally beyond the front and rear position lamps, please make sure to take the charge forward and backward marked and carry the special permission of the Road Safety Authority.

question_text: A 3-metre wide construction machine is to be transported on public roads. Under which conditions may you perform the transport?

options.text: The competent authority has issued a permit for the transport
The load need not be labelled

correct_answers.text: The competent authority has issued a permit for the transport

comment: With your 3-meter wide construction machine on public roads you must charge your mark and the competent authority must ask you a permit for the transport have been granted.

question_text: A vehicle exceeds the legal limits for maximum masses and dimensions. What applies when wanting to drive this vehicle on public roads?

options.text: An escort vehicle may be prescribed
The route of the vehicle can be freely selected

correct_answers.text: An escort vehicle may be prescribed

comment: With a special permit, you can with a support vehicle was which prescribed drive. It requires an additional permit. The route can not be freely selected.
